title: Michigan swamp gas case

tellings.quote: Michigan swamp gas. Uh you also see large disc-like objects.

plain: A guest named Merrick, on a 2025 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast framed as a challenge to the UFO skeptic Mick West, brings up the Michigan 'swamp gas' case, a sighting in Michigan that was put down to gas rising from marshland. He lists it among cases where, he says, people also reported large disc-shaped objects.
